Repair Extension configuration ownership: class-level or inherited config is a template, clone built-in dict/list/tuple/set/frozenset containers per instance before kwargs, and clone mutable values accepted by setConfig. Keep within-instance alias relationships, callback/opaque business-object identity, descriptions, existing bool/None parsing and unknown-key errors. Instance-level self.config built by existing extensions remains supported and ordinary Markdown output is unchanged. This is a complete extension lifecycle repair with real inherited/custom-extension checks.

Extend toc with opt-in unlisted_attribute="" (disabled default) and remove_unlisted_attribute=True. When enabled, presence of that exact heading attribute excludes only that heading from toc/toc_tokens, regardless of attribute value, preserving its real heading/id/body, anchor/permalink generation and descendant sections. Excluded parents do not prune child directory entries; surviving headings are nested by their real levels. Attribute removal is explicit and does not confuse data-toc-label or depth selection. Add opt-in markdown.extensions.uri_autolink with UriAutolinkExtension(schemes=(http,https,ssh,urn)). Match complete angle-bracket URI syntax before raw-HTML handling but after code/escapes, use per-instance case-insensitive validated scheme allowlists, and build ElementTree anchor attributes/AtomicString text through the real serializer. Forbid javascript/vbscript/data even if requested; unsupported schemes do not become links, ordinary HTML/email/standard autolinks keep existing semantics, and code spans/blocks never expand. No global lexer mutation or network access. Clearly state this policy controls new autolinks only and does not sanitize Markdown raw HTML as a whole.

Extend fenced_code with closing_fence="exact" default and opt-in "at_least". At-least mode accepts a standalone closing fence of the same character at least as long as the opening run, keeps shorter runs inside code, rejects mixed-character/nonstandalone closers and supports backticks/tildes, language/attrs/highlight metadata and normal escaping. Scope regex/configuration per processor instance so one conversion cannot change later default output. Unknown mode rejects. Preserve all legacy exact-mode fixtures, including the intentional historical behavior, and avoid converting container/indentation semantics not included in this delivery.

Add markdown.documents.convert_file(input,output=None,input_encoding="utf-8",output_encoding="utf-8",close_input=False,**options), building on the earlier real ConversionResult API. Accept string/PathLike paths, standard text/binary input streams from the current cursor and standard text/binary output streams; decode/encode once with independent explicit encodings. Prepare encoding before touching output paths, use same-directory temporary flush/fsync+replace, preserve existing mode, reject symlink/nonregular output and clean temporary files. Read/convert/encoding/replace failures remain explicit and keep old output bytes before replacement. Existing file APIs are unchanged.
